notes.title: The Game Now Has Settings Menu!
notes.content:
Based on players' feedback, I have developed a [b]Settings[/b] page for the game. The [b]Settings[/b] menu includes the following:
[list]
[*]Display Mode
[*]Max FPS
[*]Brightness
[*]SFX Volume
[*]Music Volume
[/list]
You can now play the game in windowed mode and adjust the volume settings!

notes.title: The Game Is Released!
notes.content:
I am thrilled to announce that the game [b]Jump & Fall[/b] is now officially released! You can now enjoy the game and compete with other players on the leaderboard. I have also removed the maximum level limitation for the Demo version. If the advanced features (skins, upgrades, leaderboards, etc.) are not that attractive to you, feel free to play the Demo version! I truly hope you enjoy this game. Thank you for playing!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229677/212f8252389a22cf2a95e74aef77d1f132dd0e0f.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Finished! Testing and Refining!
notes.content:
I am thrilled to announce that the basic development of the game is now complete, and we are moving into the testing and refining phase.

The game now features a [b]story mode[/b] that acts as a tutorial. Playing through the story mode will help players become familiar with the different types of platforms and items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229677/9c95f9a3201bf84ea1b2209da099398be7515b48.png[/img]
The game also includes an [b]in-game leaderboard[/b] with two categories: Global and Friends. The Global leaderboard displays the top 100 players worldwide, while the Friends leaderboard shows the scores of all your Steam friends who have played the game, including your own.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229677/e5a66b92e943bb59f29492fb9a3683e401759a7b.png[/img]
Additionally, the game has an [b]upgrading system[/b] where players can gain experience (EXP), level up by playing standard games, and upgrade items to enhance their effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229677/c5910c4182ab14ff3cd28b7156d5cca968ce46f7.png[/img]
We have also implemented a [b]skin system[/b] that allows players to customize the game's background and the character's appearance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229677/06300c7b52d5c10bffacedc9b1de8ec90be87075.png[/img]
Thank you for your patience! We are now focused on testing and refining the game, and we hope it brings you joy in the near future!

notes.title: New Platforms and Item!
notes.content:
I am excited to announce that our game now features two new platforms: [b]a movable platform and a platform with attacks[/b]! I have also added a new item that [b]makes your character larger[/b]! These new platforms make the game more challenging, and [b]this update has been synchronized with the demo[/b] as well. Please don't hesitate to try out the demo, and add this game to your wishlist if you find it interesting!

As for future plans, I will begin developing [b]story mode and the leaderboard[/b]. I will also continue creating new platforms and items to make the game even more engaging!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229677/5c316db3a2e112de09bdb187ac2b3b6f543863a4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229677/cd37d6cf1ca11d32093a1c0399f711d477cfe87a.png[/img]

notes.title: Jump & Fall Update [Beta 0.0.5 & Demo 1.0.1]
notes.content:
[b]We fixed[/b]
[list]
[*]Language now auto-loads from Steam settings when launching the game for the first time.
[/list]
[b]We adjusted[/b]
[list]
[*]Platform sizes now decrease as the character falls deeper.
[*]Increased the character's friction and acceleration.
[/list]

notes.title: Free Demo Released
notes.content:
Our game[b] Jump & Fall[/b] is now available for a free demo! The game is still in development, and the current version features relatively simple content. As development progresses, we will update the demo to keep it consistent with the final release version. Thank you for playing and for your support!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229677/6179410e54ef6a674d07fa957e2ae3bd998549d0.png[/img]

notes.title: Released Date Postponed To November 28th, 2024 (PST)
notes.content:
We regret to announce that we have decided to [b]delay the release of our game "Jump & Fall"[/b]. We received valuable feedback suggesting potential improvements that could enhance the game to make it truly worth its price. Since we want the game to be enjoyable and "complete" upon its release, we have chosen to postpone the launch, the new release date is [b]November 28th, 2024 (PST)[/b]

However, [b]the demo will be released as planned[/b]. It will be available on [b]October 8th, 2024 (PDT)[/b]. As we continue to develop the game and the current demo is quite simple, [b]we will keep updating the demo to match the progress of the final release[/b]. You can think of the demo as a free "early access," and we sincerely hope you enjoy our game.

While you wait for the game's release, [b]we will continue to share our development progress[/b] with you so that you can stay informed about what we are working on and what to expect in the final version. We kindly ask for your patience as we strive to make the game more enjoyable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229677/6179410e54ef6a674d07fa957e2ae3bd998549d0.png[/img]
